missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Привычка' is the feminine nominative subject. 'Плохая' is the agreeing feminine adjective and 'очень' intensifies the judgement. A natural way to label a habit.

Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Привычка' is nominative as the thing that appeared. 'Хорошая' agrees in feminine gender and 'появилась' agrees in feminine past tense. A common self-improvement phrase.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Привычку' is the accusative direct object of 'бросил'. 'Эту' and 'вредную' agree in the feminine accusative. Useful for talking about quitting something.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Привычки' takes the genitive after 'нет', which denies existence. 'Такой' agrees in the feminine genitive. A clean model for absence statements.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'По привычке' uses the dative 'привычке' after 'по' to mean out of habit. 'Просто' downplays the reason. A very idiomatic everyday phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Привычкой' is the instrumental after 'с', the thing being fought. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine instrumental. Good for describing personal struggle.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О привычке' uses the prepositional form after 'о' for the topic of talk. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine prepositional. A conversational prompt.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Привычки' is the nominative plural subject in the possession frame 'у всех есть'. 'Свои' is the agreeing possessive. Useful for general observations.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Привычек' is the genitive plural after 'от', showing what one rids oneself of. 'Старых' agrees in the genitive plural. Note the fleeting vowel in the stem.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Привычка' is nominative as the thing that interferes. 'Эта' points at a specific one and 'мне' is the dative experiencer. A practical complaint pattern.
